literal_meaning: উদ্দাম নাচের অনুকরণমূলক শব্দ (onomatopoeic sound for wild dancing movements)
figurative_meaning_en: The gesture or style of unrestrained, wild dancing
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে আনন্দে ধেই-ধেই করে নাচতে লাগল।
উৎসবে সবাই ধেই-ধেই ভঙ্গি করে নেচে উঠল।
example_sentences_in_english: She started dancing wildly in joy, dhei-dhei style.
At the festival, everyone began prancing around with unrestrained dance moves.
note: This idiom draws from traditional Bengali folk dance expressions, evoking lively, uninhibited movements often seen in rural performances.
